name: Individual Behavior in Organizations
description: This course focuses on individual behavior and its relevance to organizational context. It explores key aspects such as - personality, values, attitudes, perception, emotions, motivation, and learning etc., and how these shape behavior at workplace. Students would also be encouraged to reflect upon their own personality, attitudes, emotions, behaviour etc. and apply the insights learned from the course to enhance their effectiveness and individual growth. This course will draw upon research-driven knowledge to attain its objectives and will incorporate contemporary issues and industry relevant examples to enhance the practical value of the course.
